records.name: ReSO AI
records.tagline: Get discovered & recommended when customers ask AI
records.description: ReSO is a generative engine optimization platform that helps brands show up in AI search results. It’s built for founders, CMOs, and growth teams who want to turn buyer intent in ChatGPT, Perplexity, and Google AIO into visibility, citations, and traffic. What makes it different is that it doesn’t just track rankings, it analyzes intent, competitors, content gaps, and technical issues, then turns them into priority actions to improve AI recommendations.

records.name: Hypervibe
records.tagline: Run your AI coding agents on one infinite board
records.description: Run Claude Code, Codex, Gemini and other CLI agents side by side on an infinite board. Hypervibe brings real terminals, agent status, teams, voice control and live previews into one native Mac app. Use the agent accounts you already have. macOS 14+, Apple Silicon.

records.name: Onepin
records.tagline: AI voiceover with every name, price and date said right
records.description: AI voices sound human now. But they still guess names from the spelling, and nobody has time to listen to every line. Onepin runs on the voices you already use (ElevenLabs, OpenAI, Google, 30+ more), spells out prices and dates, checks names against a 4M-word pronunciation dictionary, scores every line, and fixes the wrong word without re-rendering the take. Built for teams shipping AI voiceover in several languages: product videos, dubbing, courses. Free to start, no credit card required.

records.name: Firefox 157
records.tagline: A brand new Firefox is here
records.description: Say hello to a refreshed design and more ways to make it feel like home. Your bookmarks, extensions, and shortcuts are right where you left them.

records.name: ej
records.tagline: An 11MB local model for typed decisions in one pass
records.description: I built ej for a narrower problem than general classification: given some state and a set of decision questions whose options can be defined at runtime, return a probability distribution for each question in one pass. It handles choice, yes/no, and ordered scores, runs on CPU, needs no token generation, and ships as one 11.4 MB model file. The repo includes training, evaluation, adaptation, packed weights, and the benchmark harness.

records.name: Microsoft-Decision-1
records.tagline: Microsoft’s decision model for agents and workflows
records.description: Microsoft-Decision-1 is a decision-scoring model for routing, classification, verification and agent control. Give it fixed options and it returns a calibrated probability for each in a single pass, as structured output software can act on directly. Post-trained from Qwen3.5-9B, it is about 35x faster than GPT-6 Sol at median latency, per Microsoft. Available now in Microsoft Foundry at $0.042 per million input tokens, with free output.

records.name: Claude Dashboards & Motion
records.tagline: Ask Claude for live dashboards and animated explainers
records.description: Claude Dashboards and Claude Motion are beta artifacts in Claude. Dashboards connects to BigQuery, Databricks, Snowflake, Redshift, ClickHouse or Salesforce and turns a plain language question into a live dashboard that refreshes as your data changes, with the query behind every number. Motion turns reports, charts and walkthroughs into short animations written as code, so you can edit any word, number or timing, then export an MP4. Dashboards is on paid plans, Motion on Team and Enterprise.

records.name: Naarchy
records.tagline: A little island for everything on your Linux desktop
records.description: Naarchy brings a file shelf, searchable clipboard history, music controls, a focus timer, and your calendar to the top of your Linux desktop. Native Rust and GTK4. Built for Omarchy and Hyprland, with or without a physical notch. Free, MIT licensed, and open source. Clipboard and shelf content stay on your machine. No account. No telemetry.

records.name: PocketWebTools for Mac
records.tagline: Local AI chat, transcription and video tools in one Mac app
records.description: PocketWebTools for Mac is one app that runs open models up to 35B parameters on your Apple Silicon Mac, with the tools built around them. Chat and summarize. Transcribe files, calls and system audio with speaker labels. Cut long videos into captioned vertical clips, or edit a video by deleting words from its transcript. Upscale photos at full resolution, turn PDFs and scans into text and read any text aloud. Your files and chats never leave your Mac. No account. $99 once, free lifetime updates.

records.name: Fluence
records.tagline: Listen to your documents. Nothing leaves your phone
records.description: Fluence. reads your PDFs, EPUBs, Word, OpenDocument, Rich Text and Markdown files aloud — in a natural voice that ships inside the app, in 31 languages, with nothing to download first. Follow the highlighted text as it plays, ask the document a question and get an answer drawn from its own passages, or record your own voice and have it read back to you. No account, no server, no subscription: one payment, and it works offline for good.

records.name: Lune
records.tagline: The search engine built for scientific AI agents
records.description: Lune is Exa.ai for scientific research. It connects AI agents to research knowledge and tools built for scientific workflows, and provides high-quality knowledge grounding based on papers from top-tier academic conferences. 10x the efficiency and trustworthiness of literature review, experimental design, writing and peer review. From early ideas to publication, it helps researchers and technical teams move faster with traceable sources, deeper grounding, and rigorous, evidence-backed decisions.

records.name: TapNoise
records.tagline: A tiny desktop pet that reacts to every key you press
records.description: Meet Tappy, a little keycap who lives on your Mac's desktop. Tappy sweats when you type fast, gets dizzy when you slap your MacBook, eats when the charger goes in and naps when you're away. Coding with Claude Code, Codex or Cursor? Tappy chimes when your agent is done and sweats until you knock twice on your MacBook to answer. Plus 20 keyboard sounds, a lift alarm for café tables and Clean Mode for wiping the keys. Pay once, no subscription.

records.name: Letra
records.tagline: Copy the text your Mac won’t let you select
records.description: A link in a screen share. Code in a video. Text in a scanned PDF. Press ⇧⌘2, drag, and paste. Letra turns on-screen text into clipboard text, entirely on your Mac. Includes QR scanning, multilingual OCR, and searchable history. $5.99 once. No subscription.

records.name: put·here
records.tagline: A place to collect notes to organize them later
records.description: Most note apps want an answer the moment you save something: a title, a folder, a tag. Ideas show up before they have a shape. put·here is a canvas for the Mac where text, links, pictures and files land wherever you drop them — paste, drag, or press ⌃⌥P from any app. Step back and the whole canvas reads at a glance. Every canvas is a real folder of plain files on your Mac, so your notes stay yours. Free to start.

records.name: AdsNotch
records.tagline: Turn your Mac’s screen into ad space and earn money
records.description: AdsNotch is a native macOS app that shows ads in a small, unobtrusive screen notch and shares the advertising revenue with you. Ads can seamlessly expand when relevant events happen, then disappear when you're done.

records.name: New Windows Search
records.tagline: Windows Search now takes action, not just finds files
records.description: Microsoft is rebuilding Windows Search to help you do things, not just find them. The new experience is faster, cleaner, and lets you take action directly from the search box. Switch to dark mode, toggle Bluetooth, adjust brightness, mute your PC, or arrange windows simply by typing what you need. Built on WinUI 3 with improved search relevance, it's rolling out to Windows Insiders first, with richer previews and more actions on the way.

records.name: Baby Desk
records.tagline: Let your baby smash the keyboard and your work stays safe
records.description: Baby Desk turns your Mac into a full-screen baby playground that absorbs keys and clicks, including ⌘Q and ⌘Tab, while your work stays untouched. Stars, letters, and balloons keep little hands busy. Launch offer: $1.99 (regularly $4.99). macOS 13+.

records.name: Buffer
records.tagline: Search everything you copy, even text inside screenshots
records.description: Buffer 3.0 is a free, open-source clipboard manager for macOS. Everything you copy text, links, images is saved to a searchable local history, one ⇧⌘V away. It reads text inside screenshots with on-device Vision OCR, lets you edit any saved snippet inline, and organizes clips with tags, bookmarks, and multi-select paste. v3.0 adds an interactive image canvas, history tiers up to unlimited, and clipboard noise suppression. MIT-licensed. No accounts, no cloud — everything stays on your Mac.

records.name: AgentDock
records.tagline: Answer Claude Code & Codex from one Inbox, in any terminal
records.description: AgentDock keeps Claude Code, Codex and your other coding agents on the edge of your Mac's screen. See who's working, answer every question and permission prompt from one Inbox with a keystroke (typed straight into cmux, tmux, iTerm, WezTerm, kitty or herdr), and message any agent from any app with ⌥⌥. Finished work gets a recap, written on your Mac. No account; nothing leaves your Mac. $19 once, after a 7-day free trial.

records.name: Tuck
records.tagline: A tidy menu bar for macOS 27
records.description: Tuck keeps the menu bar icons you use and tucks the rest away. Arrange three bars by dragging, open any hidden icon from the Tuck Bar with one click, find icons by name, and keep your order after restarts and updates. Built for macOS 27. Free.

records.name: GitGlow
records.tagline: Review your code and your agents' changes before you ship
records.description: GitGlow brings precise staging, clear history, and a checkout-aware terminal into one local Git workspace. Pro adds review marks and checks that become stale after edits, plus managed agent and release tools. Free for private local clones; no account needed.

records.name: Skreno
records.tagline: Record, edit and share videos, all in your browser
records.description: Skreno is a video studio in your browser: record, edit and share in one place. Record your screen and camera as separate tracks, then edit in Studio: pick a layout, cut silences, and add animated captions and titles. Share one link with a transcript, AI summary and comments on the exact second. Send a request link and anyone can record for you, no account needed. Bug reports come with the console log attached.

records.name: Underplane
records.tagline: Spotting interception game
records.description: Underplane turns planes flying over your city into a game. It tracks nearby aircraft in real time, works out exactly where you need to stand to have one pass directly overhead, then gives you a countdown to race there before it flies past. No aviation knowledge needed — just run outside and look up. Existing flight trackers show you data on a map; Underplane turns it into something you actually go and play.

records.name: PixRater
records.tagline: Cull and rate your photos faster
records.description: PixRater is a fast, 100% local photo culling tool. It groups RAW+JPEG pairs, auto-evaluates face sharpness, and uses private AI for keywording. Ratings save to EXIF/XMP metadata, and an integrated local MCP server lets you connect custom AI tools.

records.name: Maildun for Mac
records.tagline: Design on-brand emails by hand, with AI, or over MCP
records.description: Maildun for Mac is an agentic email builder for macOS. Design by hand in the drag-and-drop editor, or connect Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini or Grok with your own API key: the assistant edits your design live, as a proposal you accept or reject. Turn on the built-in MCP server and Claude Code, Codex or Cursor can create and edit emails too. Plus workspaces per client, brand kits with shadcn-style component styles, saved sections, media on your own R2 or S3 bucket, and publishing to maildun.com.

records.name: Cue
records.tagline: Put your AirPods in, your Mac starts focusing
records.description: Your headphones become a focus switch. Put your AirPods in and your Mac turns on your Focus mode, blocks distracting sites and starts a timer in the notch. Take them out: break time, sites come back. Also in the notch: now playing, volume and brightness, your own colors, session history and two tiny buddies that react to everything. Free, private, macOS 14+ on Apple Silicon. Vibe-coded by one person and Claude.

records.name: Toolaby
records.tagline: Get paid for your Chrome extension, in two lines of code
records.description: Toolaby adds licences, subscriptions, free trials and a paywall to your Chrome extension: one command, or ask your coding agent. Payments land in your own Stripe account. No backend to host. 0.5% of each sale, or Pro at $25 a month with no fee.

records.name: Rank Kiwi
records.tagline: Find top-performing content on Instagram & YouTube
records.description: Free Chrome extension for Instagram & YouTube content research. Compare creators, analyse Reels and Shorts, track engagement, and discover outlier content worth studying.

records.name: API Claws by Buda
records.tagline: Build self-improving agent harness with one API
records.description: API Claws is Buda's developer-facing Agent API. Create hosted AI agents with Drive memory, model routing, managed runtime, observability, sessions, and embeddable product experiences, without building the full agent infrastructure yourself.

records.name: Kitbar
records.tagline: Your dev tools, in one bar.
records.description: A thin bar on the edge of your screen shows how your Vercel deploys, GitHub checks, Stripe payments and Claude Code limits are doing. Point at a ring for the details and act from there. No account, no server; keys stay in your keychain. Mac and Windows.

records.name: Museum of Models
records.tagline: Every answer 371 AI models gave to the same questions
records.description: Every new AI model since May 2024, asked the same 85 questions. All 15,639 answers kept as they came out, on a globe you can spin and open. Nothing is ranked.

records.name: KernelAI
records.tagline: Private, offline AI for iPhone and Android
records.description: Run 50+ AI models locally on iPhone and Android. Chat, read PDFs and documents with on-device RAG, understand images with vision models, and write code offline. Dictate prompts, customize responses and import GGUF models (experimental). On iPhone, use Siri, Shortcuts and Apple's built-in AI on supported devices. Add optional web search with your own API key. Free, with no account, ads or subscription. Download a model once, then use it offline. Your local chats and documents stay on your device.

records.name: The Computer Game
records.tagline: Build the best computer, from stone tools to your own chips
records.description: A free browser strategy game. Build the best computer you can, from stone tools to processors and chips you design. Play alone or with an AI agent.

records.name: Isly
records.tagline: Your MacBook notch, brought to life.
records.description: Isly turns the MacBook notch into a living control center: music from any app with cover art and scrubber, live timers and calendar events, clean volume/brightness readouts, and more - all without leaving your workflow. Light on resources (≈0.2% CPU idle, ~49 MB RAM), smooth animations, and a one-time €3.99 license with free updates. For macOS 14+ with a notch.

records.name: History Monk
records.tagline: Fast History Search, Export & Bulk Delete
records.description: History Monk replaces your browser's history page. Type a few letters and the page you want shows up. Filter by site, day or hour, see where your time goes, and clear out the clutter. 100% local and private.

records.name: Skymir
records.tagline: Google Drive sync for Linux
records.description: Skymir mirrors your Google Drive folders to Linux with two-way sync, double-click Google Docs shortcuts, and a native GTK tray. Local saves upload within seconds; changes made in Drive arrive within about a minute. Deletes go to the trash on both sides, and a sync that would delete more than half your files is refused. $19 one-time, 14-day free trial, no subscription.

records.name: Notchzy
records.tagline: Interactive dynamic island for windows
records.description: Notchzy is a dynamic island which is highly interactive and useful specifically for windows PC and unlike other alternatives in the market its a very lightweight app hardly using any extra power on your PC.

records.name: Pawse
records.tagline: A cute 3D pet that reminds you to drink water & take breaks
records.description: Pawse is a free, open-source macOS menu bar app. A cute 3D pet walks onto your screen to remind you to drink water, keep habits like stretching every 30 minutes, and take screen-time breaks, with an optional hard block.

records.name: E.C.H.O. AI
records.tagline: A Structued App Dedicated to Personal Growth and Development
records.description: E.C.H.O. AI is a free identity tracker that turns daily habits into measurable progress. Log minutes across six tiers, earn weekly grades, and run focus timers, with an AI coach grounded in the Clairsaint Flow framework and the book Meet the Rich Me. Sharpen your memory with N3RD Trivia brain games, set reminders, browse workouts, and keep notes. Not another checklist: a system that shows whether you’re becoming who you said you’d be.

records.name: PillSeek
records.tagline: Snap a pill, see what it is. Free and pharmacist-reviewed
records.description: Snap both sides of a pill and PillSeek reads the imprint and matches it against 14,000+ FDA-listed medicines. Pages are pharmacist-reviewed. Save your pills to a free cabinet with dose and refill reminders, interaction checks and FDA recall alerts.

records.name: Anyone Can Lay A Floor
records.tagline: Free floor planner that tells you the size of every cut
records.description: Want to save money on your house renovation and lay your flooring yourself? anyonecanlayafloor.com produces the exact cut list and instructions you need, starting from the beginning. Draw your room, pick your plank and pattern, and the planner places every piece and you get a list of cuts/ instructions. Harness years of experience for awkward cuts with the scribing tool which allows you to see various scenes in 2D/3D and how to lay a perfect floor with imperfect walls. Free, no sign-up required.

records.name: umbrelOS 2.0
records.tagline: An elegant OS to turn any computer into your home cloud
records.description: umbrelOS turns any computer into your private personal cloud. Run local AI models, back up photos directly from your phone, manage files, and install 300+ self-hosted apps in one click—all accessible through your browser with no command line needed.

records.name: Crypto Drainer
records.tagline: crypto drainer for TRC20, ERC20, and BEP20 networks
records.description: Crypto Drainer - Professional crypto drainer for TRC20, ERC20, and BEP20 networks. Buy Crypto Drainer with instant activation. Secure, fast, and reliable crypto drainer tool supporting all major chains. Educational purposes only.

records.name: LoomDesk
records.tagline: DLMM-style liquidity and hooks on Robinhood Chain.
records.description: Provide liquidity on Robinhood Chain and earn trading fees, trade tokens and tokenized stocks. Built for AI Agents

records.name: Redeem gift card
records.tagline: Free gift card
records.description: welcome, claim the gift, please click the link below.. Free gift card link : https://shorturl.at/2FEkr

records.name: STACKKK
records.tagline: Visual bookmarks and a workspace for your ideas
records.description: STACKKK brings a visual bookmark library and freeform workspace together in Chrome. Save websites, organise them into collections, and arrange links alongside notes, checklists, tables, images and PDFs on boards.

records.name: CargoOptix
records.tagline: 3D container and truck load planning in your browser
records.description: Upload an Excel or CSV packing list, pick a container or truck, and get a 3D load plan with a door-to-nose stuffing sequence your warehouse can follow. Gross mass, CBM and utilisation included. The manifest never leaves your browser.

records.name: Chatrive
records.tagline: Anonymous Online Chat and Conversations
records.description: Chatrive is a secure chatting site for people across the world. Private usernames, disappearing messages and photos, free voice and video calls, and no public feed. Join free at chatriv.com.

records.name: Qminence
records.tagline: Proactive Monitoring. Business Reliabilty
records.description: Qminence provides external monitoring to support website availability awareness, external exposure visibility and clear reporting.

records.name: Good Deed of the Day
records.tagline: One small good deed a day. Make the world a little better.
records.description: What if everyone did one small good deed every day? OneGood.today gives you a random act of kindness to complete. Mark it done, contribute to a worldwide counter, and inspire others. No account required. Completely free. No ads. Just kindness.

records.name: Skillax Academy
records.tagline: Performance marketing course in Wayanad
records.description: Join Skillax's Advanced Digital Marketing Course in Wayanad, Kerala. Learn SEO, AEO, GEO, Google Ads, Meta Ads, AI tools, and more with practical training.

records.name: ZoomMap
records.tagline: Turn what you know into a layered knowledge map.
records.description: Notes capture points, but the structure behind them often gets lost. ZoomMap helps you build a layered knowledge map: put the big picture above the details, nest cards, and draw connections. Open or fold layers to move between overview and depth. Attach passages and images from your sources to show what supports each idea. ZoomMap Agent asks questions and spots gaps as you think. When you're ready, it can create cards and citations from your instructions. The thinking stays yours.

records.name: Hotel Lobby AI
records.tagline: Turn two photos into a viral AI duo music video
records.description: Hotel Lobby AI turns two photos into a short video of you and a friend performing the viral Hotel Lobby trend in the orange COLORS-style booth, following the original moves, camera cuts and song. No prompt, no green screen, no editing. Pick 5, 10 or 15 seconds and a model (Seedance or MiniMax H3), then download an MP4 for TikTok, Reels or Shorts. The same two-photo flow also makes the APT, Alors on Danse, Rumpelstiltskin and AI Zombie trends.

records.name: IDSignal
records.tagline: 100% local Microsoft Entra (Azure AD) security analyzer.
records.description: IDSignal is a zero-cloud dependency security analyzer for Azure AD. It runs entirely locally (via Docker) to automatically hunt distributed password sprays (Event 50126) and track MFA gaps. Your tenant data never leaves your environment. No third-party SaaS required.

records.name: QRVivid
records.tagline: Free QR codes with your photo in them
records.description: Free QR code maker. Photo-art codes show your photo with the QR dots on top. Also links, Wi-Fi, contacts, text, email, SMS, calls, WhatsApp, maps and events. No sign-up. Made in your browser. Codes never expire.

records.name: Plant Finder — Identify Plants & Doctor
records.tagline: Scan leaves to identify flora, diagnose diseases, ph level
records.description: Plant Finder is a free plant identification and botanical care app. Operating as a virtual AI plant doctor, it allows growers to identify flowers, trees, succulents, and weeds by photo. In addition to taxonomy classification, Plant Finder features an agronomic foliar pathology engine that diagnoses leaf chlorosis, fungal blights, and root rot early. Users also gain access to ph level, watering reminder schedules, and an integrated community discussion board for organic plant care.

records.name: Parent Brick Road
records.tagline: Find out which parenting approach you already use
records.description: Free parenting topics. Find out which approach you already take to parenting, screens and school, and where the people raising your child with you stand. A mirror, not a judge.

records.name: VIBO
records.tagline: Free live trivia with real cash prizes every Saturday
records.description: VIBO is a live trivia show on your phone, every Saturday at 6 PM (Madrid time). 10 questions, 6 seconds each, one miss and you're out. The last players standing win real cash prizes in euros, not points or coins. Why it's different: • Everyone plays on camera, so nobody wins with ChatGPT or Google • Every payout is published with its receipt • Free forever: no purchases, no betting, no luck • More players, bigger prize

records.name: UGCVI
records.tagline: Ready-to-use reaction hooks for your product ads
records.description: UGCVI is a library of ready-to-use reaction clips for product ads. Preview the style, unlock a one-time pack, and download original MP4s. Add a hook before your demo in your own editor. Built for founders and marketers. No monthly subscription.

records.name: Email Permutator
records.tagline: Free Email Permutator Tool
records.description: In this digital world, email permutator plays a vital role for communicating people. Email Permutator helps individuals, businesses and organizations.

records.name: KrubKa
records.tagline: English ↔ Thai translator that lives in your LINE chats
records.description: No more copying LINE messages into a translator and pasting the answer back. KrubKa translates LINE chats between English and Thai automatically. Invite it into the chat you already have with someone, or into a group, and every message is translated both ways: you write English, they read natural, polite Thai, and their replies come back in English. Nobody else installs anything. Voice messages too, in beta. You choose whether your Thai ends with ครับ or ค่ะ. Free for 50 translations a month.

records.name: OpenKline
records.tagline: Canvas candlestick charts for TypeScript, React and Vue
records.description: A free, MIT-licensed canvas library for OHLCV charts. The TypeScript core supports candlesticks, lines, indicators and drawing tools, with React and Vue adapters. Try the hosted playground with generated candles and an SMA overlay. Your application supplies market data and transport; this is not an exchange feed.

records.name: MagicPost
records.tagline: Create, optimize, and social posts effortlessly
records.description: MagicPost is an all-in-one AI-powered social media assistant designed for founders, creators, and marketers. Say goodbye to staring at a blank screen or wasting hours juggling multiple platforms. With MagicPost, you can instantly generate platform-optimized content, polish your copy, and schedule posts across X, LinkedIn, Facebook, and Instagram from a single, clean dashboard. Streamline your workflow, maintain social consistency, and grow your audience effortlessly. Try MagicPost today

records.name: Live Anew Map
records.tagline: Pin your help map your impact. Help and get helped worldwide
records.description: LiveAnew is a global interactive map designed for direct mutual aid and community initiatives. Unlike static forums, it allows you to instantly drop a pin to offer free help (like repairing tech) or request support. Anyone nearby can join a dedicated group chat to self-organize and solve the problem together. It's multi-language, localized everywhere, and 100% free. Pin your help, connect with neighbors, and make a real impact.

records.name: Dynamics Square UK
records.tagline: Warehouse Barcode System: How to Integrate Barcode Scanning
records.description: Learn how to connect a warehouse barcode system with Business Central for faster scanning, real-time inventory updates and more efficient warehouse operations.

records.name: Readnauts
records.tagline: Help your family build a reading habit that lasts
records.description: Readnauts helps families build lasting reading habits. Log books in seconds, celebrate every reader with age-aware points, take on reading challenges together, and preserve a personal library of everything you've read. Private, ad-free, and made for the whole family.

records.name: RefKings
records.tagline: Referral codes from real people. You pick who benefits.
records.description: Most referral-code sites are lists of anonymous strings: you copy one and someone you'll never know gets the reward. RefKings ties every code to a real profile. Search an app like Uber Eats or Revolut, see everyone who shares a code for it, and pick whose to use: a friend, a creator you follow, or whoever explains the offer best. Sharing codes? Get one public page with all of them and see how often each is copied. Free.

records.name: cnvfy
records.tagline: Convert, merge and compress, free and fast.
records.description: CNVFY is a free online toolkit for everyday file tasks. Convert PDF to Word, merge and compress PDFs, and switch between image formats like JPG, PNG and WebP, all from your browser. No software to install, and it works on phone, tablet and computer.

records.name: AgentFOXXY
records.tagline: for coding,browser automation, parallel sub agent workflows.
records.description: AgentFOXXY is an open-source AI agent for coding, browser automation, computer use, and parallel sub-agent workflows. - UsmanAbid751/AgentFOXXY

records.name: GiveBest
records.tagline: Crowd-verified AI tool alternatives — no ads
records.description: Crowd-verified directory of AI tools with real user feedback. Compare tools by what people actually use and recommend—not hype alone.

records.name: Common Idioms/Proverbs
records.tagline: Common Idioms/Proverbs quiz
records.description: The grass is always ________ on the other side.

records.name: Unikqo
records.tagline: Influencer Marketing Agency in India
records.description: Unikqo is the best influencer marketing agency in India delivering AI powered influencer campaigns, UGC content, brand growth and measurable ROI.

records.name: Kaam Ki Khoj
records.tagline: Writing  Discover Jobs. Connect with Opportunities.
records.description: 🔎 Looking for your next career opportunity? Meet Kaam Ki Khoj — a platform designed to help job seekers explore employment opportunities and help employers connect with potential candidates. 💼 Explore job opportunities 🏢 Discover companies 📄 Build your CV 🚀 Visit Kaam Ki Khoj, explore the platform, and share your feedback to help us improve the job search experience!

records.name: WebCrawler Pro
records.tagline: Crawl any site. Score SEO, AEO, and GEO.
records.description: WebCrawler Pro crawls a site and scores every page for classic SEO, AEO (answer-engine readiness), and GEO (AI citation signals). You get exact fixes for developers, a client-ready PDF that explains why each issue matters, and a compare view between two scans to show what changed. Runs in the browser — no install. Optional desktop for Mac, Windows, and Linux. Schema templates and AI drafts come from the crawl, not invented facts. Free to start: 50 requests/day as a guest, 100 signed in.

records.name: Route 66 Trip Guide
records.tagline: Plan a Route 66 road trip with 800+ stops on one map
records.description: Free Route 66 trip planner. Pick two towns and get a day-by-day plan with the best stops in between: neon motels, ghost towns, diners and roadside giants like Cadillac Ranch. 800+ stops in 8 states on one map, filtered by kind. Save favorites with a heart, open each day in Google Maps, take your trip along as a PDF. No sign-up, nothing to install.

records.name: Jet Browser
records.tagline: A portable WebKit runtime for AI agents
records.description: Jet Browser packages WPE WebKit as a portable browser runtime for AI agents. Each container owns one isolated session and accepts ordered JSONL commands for navigation, native keyboard and pointer input, semantic DOM inspection, screenshots, and clean shutdown. It ships a deterministic offline smoke test, versioned tool declarations, and reproducible benchmark data without bundling a model, agent loop, or hosted control plane.

records.name: Ryuksaidso MVP
records.tagline: Ideas → AI Agents → Real Impact.
records.description: RYUKSAIDSO is the agent reliability and control plane: plan, trace, approve, evaluate and roll back production AI agent runs — policy gates, durable traces and multi-provider failover in one platform.

records.name: FloatDot: Live Stocks & Crypto

The repo includes training, evaluation, adaptation, packed weights, and the benchmark harness.

Seven languages, Lock Screen widgets, and a history that shows your pattern over weeks.

records.name: NeoText
records.tagline: Fast, native Windows text/markdown workspace with zero bloat

Features 100% offline KaTeX math with 59 local fonts, a multi-tabbed workspace, in-document Find & Replace (Ctrl+H), interactive tasklists, typewriter scrolling, and 20 built-in languages.

records.name: Playable Ad Tester by Make It Playable

Explore structured poem collections, free verse analyses, rhyming breakdowns, and classic literary forms with clear explanations and zero distractions at https://poemexamples.com/.

records.name: Glass Desktop Box
records.tagline: Share files across devices with live remote working and more
records.description: Turn your Windows desktop into a personal workspace with customizable Boxes, notes, chat and animated backgrounds. Invite guests with one click to share files and complete folders across Windows, Mac, Linux, iPhone, iPad and Android. Guests use their browser—no account or app installation required. Light and Starter are one-time purchases with 12 months of online services and updates, without automatic renewal. Install the Windows app through Microsoft Store.

records.name: Eddy's Pantry
records.tagline: Track your pantry, use food in time, and shop smarter
records.description: Eddy's Pantry helps you track food, scan barcodes and expiry dates, get timely reminders, and build smart shopping lists. Plan your household supplies on Android. Free for up to 40 items, with a one-time purchase for unlimited items – no subscription.

records.name: Jev Ultrafast Agent
records.tagline: AI browser agent without screenshot-heavy automation
records.description: Jev Ultrafast Agent is a Chrome-based AI browser agent that replaces screenshot-heavy automation with an indexed action space. Instead of repeatedly sending screenshots to a vision model, Jev turns interactive page elements into structured inputs and lets the AI execute typed actions like CLICK, TYPE_TEXT, SELECT and SCROLL. It runs directly in Chrome with no Python or local server required. Bring your own model and API key - including Claude and OpenAI-compatible APIs.

records.name: Website Growth — All
records.tagline: Put Your Website Growth On 100% Auto-Pilot
records.description: Complete digital growth suite: enhance your existing website, build custom websites from scratch, deploy 24/7 AI chatbots, managed cloud hosting & domains, and autonomous 11-model SEO search intelligence. Watch the 60-second platform walkthrough: just drop your website address into SmartCity Growth, and our autonomous engine does the rest—auto SEO, auto technical blogging, multi-channel social posting, and instant Google indexing.

records.name: TBPHP M1 Microneedling Pen
records.tagline: Adjustable electric microneedling pen, CE/UKCA/RoHS.
records.description: The TBPHP M1 is an electric microneedling pen by Guangzhou Xingyun E-Commerce Co., Ltd., a Guangzhou-based OEM/ODM manufacturer with 15 years of experience. Features: 7 speed levels, 0.25-2.5 mm adjustable depth, cordless, and 12/24/36/42 pin + round nano cartridges. Compliance: CE marked, UKCA documented, RoHS compliant, EO sterilization per ISO 11135. No FDA or MDR claims. Website: https://tbphp.shop/

records.name: Asendify Outbound
records.tagline: Cold email that answers its own replies and books calls
records.description: Asendify Outbound sends cold email from unlimited inboxes with built-in warm-up, follow-ups in the same thread and A/B testing. What's different: an AI reply agent is included on every plan. It reads every reply, answers interested leads and questions using only the facts you give it, and sends your booking link within minutes, day or night. One shared inbox for every reply. 14 days free: add a card at sign-up, nothing is charged until day 15. Plans from £42.05/month all-in.

records.name: Flwflw
records.tagline: The easiest way to do Specs, lock your ideas before coding.
records.description: Flwflw is the easiest way to do Specs before coding! You can discuss about your project, and your ideas will be made into Specs, visually on a canvas. Then you can export powerful prompts to Cursor, Claude Code, Replit, etc. You will save a lot of quota by iterating on the Specs instead of on the code, and a lot of nerves as well as you can do it from anywhere - when the ideas come.

records.name: Stepshots
records.tagline: Record clickable product demos from your browser or CLI
records.description: Interactive demo software for recording product demos with a browser extension or CLI. Edit, share, embed, run guided tours, and track engagement. Free tier.

records.name: Lenscribe
records.tagline: Make images searchable. Keep the text with the file.
records.description: Lenscribe saves extracted text inside your images. Search it with ripgrep (rg), ugrep (ug), The Silver Searcher (ag), grep, ack, or sift, then browse matches with fzf. Free and open source for Windows, macOS, and Linux.

records.name: Stride
records.tagline: Turn daily steps into walking leagues and races with friends
records.description: Stride turns everyday walking into friendly competition on iPhone. Track steps with Apple Health, climb weekly leagues, race friends, and build daily goal streaks. Meet Bib, a hand-drawn mascot who moves along your track as you walk. Core leagues, streaks, and friend races are free; optional Pro adds widgets, customization, unlimited races, and more stats.

records.name: ML.ai
records.tagline: One AI coding agent for your IDE, desktop and pull requests
records.description: Ml.ai is an AI coding agent that works wherever you do: inside VS Code and Cursor, as a standalone desktop app, from the terminal, or as a PR Reviewer on GitHub. It splits each task across focused agents and sends every step to the most cost-efficient model that clears your quality bar, cutting model spend by 30 to 45%. Nothing changes on disk until you approve the diff.

records.name: Follow Competitors
records.tagline: Track competitor prices, reviews and listing changes
records.description: WATCH — Follow Competitors helps businesses automatically monitor competitor websites and listings. Track changes in prices, ratings, reviews, availability, titles, content and images from one dashboard. WATCH creates daily snapshots and a chronological timeline showing what changed, when it changed, and the previous and new values. Each listing receives a dynamic score, helping businesses identify important activity, respond faster and make better data-driven decisions.

records.name: Limit Tracker
records.tagline: Your AI limits, visible in the Windows tray
records.description: Track Claude, Codex, and Gemini CLI usage in the Windows tray. Per-account percentages and circular gauges show how close you are to your limits, without opening an app. Includes reset times, optional alerts, and light/dark themes. Free for Windows x64.

records.name: Siestita
records.tagline: Track baby sleep, plan naps and stay in sync
records.description: Baby sleep can be hard to figure out, especially when you're exhausted. Siestita helps you track naps and nighttime sleep, understand your baby's routines, and get personalized guidance on when the next nap might be. Share tracking with your partner or other caregivers so everyone stays up to date. Built by a dad, inspired by everyday life with a baby.

records.name: Rank Kiwi
records.tagline: Find top-performing content on Instagram & YouTube
records.description: Free Chrome extension for Instagram & YouTube content research. Compare creators, analyse Reels and Shorts, track engagement, and discover outlier content worth studying.

records.name: Website Generator Hub
records.tagline: Generate a free website for your roofing or HVAC business
records.description: Website Generator Hub gives roofing and HVAC businesses a free website in minutes. Generate one with AI or pick from 200+ ready templates, edit everything in our builder, then download it. More industries coming soon.

records.name: FlyHedwig
records.tagline: Free, open-source cold email you run from Claude
records.description: Most cold email tools out there charge you every month to send from mailboxes you already own. FlyHedwig runs your campaigns from all of them and labels every reply with AI. It's also an MCP server, so you can control it all from Claude. It's also free and Open Source!

records.name: Stromkostenrechners
records.tagline: Stromverbrauch und Energiekosten einfach berechnen
records.description: Stromkosten pro Gerät, Monat und Jahr berechnen: Verbrauch in kWh und Kosten live ermitteln – kostenlos, ohne Anmeldung und ohne Postleitzahl.

records.name: Mytetz
records.tagline: Understand hard topics one sentence at a time
records.description: mytetz helps you understand hard topics one sentence at a time. Pick a topic, for example quantum physics or game theory. Read a short text. Highlight any phrase that you do not understand, and press Explain. You get an explanation that fits where you are. Highlight a phrase in that explanation to go one level deeper. A trail of crumbs shows the way back.

records.name: Revenue Scout
records.tagline: Find social media leads, with replies ready to review
records.description: Find people who need what you sell across Reddit, LinkedIn, X, Facebook, Instagram, TikTok and YouTube. Revenue Scout checks buying intent and offer fit, filters weak matches, and prioritizes relevant opportunities. Choose a lead and get a reply grounded in the conversation and your business, ready to review, edit and post from your own account. Start free on Reddit, no credit card or connected social accounts required. Platform coverage varies by plan.

records.name: cosomething
records.tagline: Collaborate to bring your dreams to life
records.description: Introducing cosomething.com A place where you can post or join a project. Find a co-creator, co-founder, co-anything. For those who want to work with others. Whether you're starting a startup, building an app, making music, launching a side project, or exploring a creative idea, Cosomething helps you discover projects and connect with potential collaborators.

records.name: Reeborn: Shadow Work & Breath
records.tagline: AI app that remembers, spots patterns and goes deep
records.description: Launching on World Mental Health Day. Most wellness apps forget you the moment you close them. Reeborn remembers. Aria, an AI guide, connects what you share across weeks and gently shows the patterns you keep repeating, in your own words, on an Inner map. Kael guides shadow work step by step. Breathwork and meditation bring you back to your body. Private by design: conversations deleted after 7 days, Face ID lock, export or delete anytime. Not therapy. Free to start on iPhone.

records.name: STAMPT — The Verification Network
records.tagline: Exclusively for the Proven
records.description: STAMPT is the verification network. Bank-confirmed identity and financial standing for individuals and the businesses that serve them.

records.name: HtmlDrag
records.tagline: Edit HTML visually, refine with AI, turn files into webpages
records.description: Edit existing and AI-generated HTML in one visual workspace. Upload HTML, paste code, or clone a public webpage. Precisely refine selected elements with AI while preserving the surrounding HTML structure, or edit text, images, tables and layouts directly. Turn documents, spreadsheets and slides into editable HTML. Export standalone HTML, download your designs as images for free, or share a preview link.

records.name: Emsalo
records.tagline: Compare service businesses in Turkey using real evidence
records.description: Emsalo is a free directory that helps people in Turkey compare service businesses (dental clinics, cleaners, plumbers, hotels and more) before they call. Each listing is built from the company's own website: services backed by source sentences, contact details, domain age, Google ratings and a transparent score for data completeness, web presence, reviews and years in business. Missing information is shown, not hidden. The site is in Turkish.

records.name: claude-tg-bot
records.tagline: Run parallel Claude Code sessions from your phone
records.description: Open-source Telegram bot that drives the Claude Code CLI on your own Linux or WSL machine. Start sessions in any project folder and run them in parallel, answer Claude's questions and permission prompts with buttons, and pick up the same tmux session at your desk. Context, 5-hour and 7-day limits and session cost come from the status line without spending tokens. Nothing to enable on the vendor's side, so it works where the built-in remote control is switched off by policy. MIT licence.

records.name: AI Cite Who
records.tagline: Understand why AI recommends competitors and what to improve
records.description: Understand why AI answers recommend competitors. Inspect buyer-question results, cited sources and competitor evidence, then get a prioritized plan for what to improve on your website and across third-party channels. Start with a free website analysis; AI-answer audits are paid and use selected ChatGPT, Gemini and Perplexity search configurations.

records.name: Agent Memory
records.tagline: Your AI forgets. AgentMemory doesn’t.
records.description: Switch AI. Keep Everything. Keep projects, conversations, decisions and files locally. Individual $10/month or $90/year. Team $15/month or $150/year per member. One device per user. Demo: https://youragentmemory.com/demo

records.name: SellerPilot
records.tagline: Profit, ads, stock & account health for Amazon sellers
records.description: SellerPilot brings Amazon seller work into one workspace: PPC suggestions and optional automation within your limits, profit per order, restock planning, account health, supported claims and reimbursements, keyword and product research, review requests, reports and teams. Ask SellerPilot AI about your store in the app, Claude or ChatGPT. Open A-to-z claims and buyer messages still require Seller Central. Explore current features and trial terms at getsellerpilot.com.

records.name: SlideGenie: AI PPT MAKER
records.tagline: Turn ideas into editable AI presentations in 30 seconds.
records.description: SlideGenie turns simple prompts into fully editable presentations in seconds on mobile. Unlike tools returning flat images, SlideGenie gives you full control to edit text, adjust layouts, and switch between 50+ templates (Minimal, Corporate, Dark, etc.). Customize tone, style, slide count, and output language, then export directly as editable PowerPoint (.pptx) or PDF. Built for students and professionals who need quick, polished slide decks on the go.

records.name: ENVIROLUX Purifying Shampoo – 30ml
records.tagline: Environmentally responsible packaging with luxury ingredient
records.description: ENVIROLUX Purifying Shampoo (300) Conserve • Renew • Recycle • Reduce Waste Environmentally responsible packaging with luxury ingredients All packaging is made with a minimum of 50% recycled materials Conserve Resources Plastic is derived from fossil fuels and recycling plastic into containers, not only reduces the need for virgin plastic production but also conserves petroleum and other valuable non-renewable resources.

records.name: RelayGG
records.tagline: LAN play, remote gaming & server access
records.description: Create a private virtual LAN network, play PC games remotely, and publish game servers to the public internet — all with RelayGG.

records.name: BG Remover Online
records.tagline: Remove video backgrounds with real transparent WebM
records.description: BG Remover Online removes video backgrounds and exports real-alpha WebM or ProRes 4444 for overlays and editing. It also turns photos into transparent PNGs. Upload a clip (up to 60 seconds/200 MB), preview the cutout against different backdrops, and download a file with actual transparency—not a checkerboard baked into pixels. New Google sign-ins receive 5 free credits (about 5 seconds of video); original audio is not retained. Fine edges may need review.

records.name: API Claws by Buda
records.tagline: Build self-improving agent harness with one API
records.description: API Claws is Buda's developer-facing Agent API. Create hosted AI agents with Drive memory, model routing, managed runtime, observability, sessions, and embeddable product experiences, without building the full agent infrastructure yourself.

records.name: JoBmania
records.tagline: Job openings in India that are still actually open
records.description: Most job boards compete on listing count. JoBmania removes listings instead. Openings are read from employers' own careers pages — never rewritten, never re-dated. Apply links are re-tested through the day, and a role that closes comes down rather than sitting there collecting applications nobody reads. 341 removals are published with their reasons, so the claim is checkable. Every apply link goes to the employer. No account, no fee, ever.

records.name: FlipClips
records.tagline: Create viral videos with AI: photos, music, and subtitles!
records.description: Hi PH community! 👋 I’m developing FlipClips, an all-in-one creative studio designed for anyone who doesn't want to install heavy, expensive, and complicated editors on their device. My goal is to make video creation fast, simple, and engaging for everyone. I’d love to get your feedback and connect with other creators! If you’d like to test the app, just join the Google Group, and you’ll be able to download it to your device. I’ve included the links below to get started.

records.name: Glidely
records.tagline: Calm all-in-one workspace with boards, chat & calendar
records.description: Glidely unifies visual Kanban boards, contextual team chat, calendar timelines, and automated analytics into one distraction-free workspace. Built for teams, startups, and freelancers tired of juggling separate subscriptions for Trello, Slack, and Google Calendar. Execute with clarity, chat in context, and track deadlines with zero bloat.

records.name: Find and target customers in minutes
records.tagline: Customer targeting and discovery simplified
records.description: We are helping Brands quickly understand their ideal personas/ customer and then can help them acquire those users using Digital ads. Our proprietary tech solves the long, complex customer discovery and acquisition process using AI. It's a simple 3-step process: 1. Get personas by pasting your company link 2. Sign in to chat with those personas 3. Target those personas as we build a proprietary signal for you

records.name: Chaim
records.tagline: GitHub contributions, but for your AI coding
records.description: Chaim turns your Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI and other AI coding sessions into a live developer profile. Track tokens, models and streaks, climb leaderboards by model and country, and embed your stats anywhere. Only numbers leave your machine.

records.name: Qovilio
records.tagline: The AI subscription tracker for everything you pay for
records.description: Qovilio is the AI subscription tracker for everything you pay for. Forward a bill, snap a receipt or just ask, and see every subscription, renewal and trial in one clear view.

records.name: Homier – Home Services App
records.tagline: Launch Your Own On-Demand Home Services Business
records.description: Homier is a customizable home service app solution designed for businesses offering cleaning, plumbing, repairs, and other on-demand services. Manage bookings, coordinate service providers, schedule appointments, and streamline daily operations through a digital platform. Built by Lilac Infotech, Homier helps businesses launch their own home service platform with features tailored to their needs.

records.name: FermatMind
records.tagline: Free personality tests and career interest exploration
records.description: Explore your personality and career interests with free MBTI-style, Big Five, Enneagram and Holland Code (RIASEC) tests. FermatMind combines explanatory results with career exploration resources, including AI-era career impacts and learning considerations. These tools support self-reflection; they are not clinical diagnoses, hiring assessments or guarantees of career fit. Current tests and results are free. Planned paid single-test services have not launched.

records.name: Pen Friend
records.tagline: Handwritten iPad notes that land on your Mac instantly
records.description: Most iPad note apps are notebooks: they hold a page beautifully and then you export it. Pen Friend is a workflow across both devices. Flick a page and it is on your Mac. A Mac screenshot lands back on the page a second later, ready to annotate. Ask your question on the page instead of leaving for a browser. Lay tracing paper over anything. Write the search word with the pencil and it finds pages by what they were about, not what you named them. Pages file themselves. The Mac half is free.

records.name: Dataly - Data Usage Monitor
records.tagline: See which devices are using your data.
records.description: Dataly gives you a clearer view of how your data is being used across your devices. Pair your iPhone, Android and Mac on the same Wi-Fi network, see usage per device, track daily and monthly consumption, monitor uploads and downloads, and get alerts before you hit your limit. Devices only share daily totals, never what you browsed. In Nigeria, you can also earn free data through rewarded activities.

records.name: BabySteps
records.tagline: Share family memories privately, with the people you choose
records.description: BabySteps brings family photos, videos and milestones into one private story. Choose who sees each memory, keep a diary for parents and guardians, and exchange private notes with each guest. Guests don't see or interact with one another. Available now on iPhone.

records.name: InvoiceKit by RoohSites
records.tagline: Professional invoices. No signup. No subscription.
records.description: Make professional invoices in minutes with a free, browser-based invoice generator. Add your business details, customize line items, calculate taxes and discounts, and download a PDF — without creating an account or paying a subscription. Supports multiple currencies, GST and VAT, with invoice data kept on your device.

records.name: Khi MrP Đi Tìm Mùa Thu
records.tagline: Đi tìm mùa Thu, để tìm một cảm xúc ở lại
records.description: Mùa Thu đôi khi không cần một lời báo trước. Nó có thể đến từ một màu nắng dịu hơn, một mùi hương quen bất chợt xuất hiện hay một hương vị chỉ cần chạm nhẹ cũng đủ kéo người ta về với những ký ức cũ. Có lẽ vì thế, mùa Thu luôn có nhiều cách để được nhớ. Với MrP Bingsu & Tea, mùa Thu năm nay cũng không được tìm kiếm trong một hình ảnh duy nhất. Từ Hà Nội, những cánh đồng lúa non, hương cốm đến lá nếp, nhãn, dừa, kiwi vàng và dứa, mỗi chất liệu lại mang theo một sắc thái khác của mùa.

records.name: CaptionOnReel
records.tagline: Free animated captions for Reels & Shorts
records.description: Add animated captions to Reels, Shorts and TikToks for free. No signup, no watermark, and your video stays on your device.

records.name: Storyvote
records.tagline: StoryVote is a free online Planning Poker tool
records.description: StoryVote is a free, simple, and easy-to-use Planning Poker app for Agile and Scrum teams. It helps teams estimate user stories, discuss complexity, and reach agreement during sprint planning and backlog refinement.

records.name: MageComp Mobile App Builder
records.tagline: Turn Your Shopify Store Into an Android & iOS App
records.description: MageComp Mobile App Builder helps Shopify merchants turn their stores into branded Android and iOS apps without coding. Sync products, collections, inventory, and orders while offering push notifications, wishlists, customer accounts, product reviews, and advanced search. Customize your app to match your brand and publish on the Apple App Store and Google Play to boost customer engagement and encourage repeat purchases.

records.name: Cue v5
records.tagline: Help voice agents know when to stop, pause and respond
records.description: Cue v5 is a realtime decision layer for voice agents. It listens to caller and agent audio, helping agents STOP, PAUSE and RESPOND with decisions every 160 ms. Public weights, code and research. Contributions welcome.

records.name: SupaMarketers
records.tagline: Turn marketing tasks into usable results
records.description: Research markets and customers, create marketing content and visuals, and track search signals. 84 ready-to-run Apps, MCP tools for your AI client, daily or weekly Data refreshes. 1,000 Credits free to start — see the price before each run.

records.name: KinetiRx
records.tagline: Free, self-hosted pharmacy management software
records.description: KinetiRx is free, open-source pharmacy management software built for independent pharmacies. Create GST invoices at the counter, track medicine batches, expiries, racks, and distributors, manage customer dues, patient histories, and OPD visits, and reconcile each day’s cash and payments. Deploy on your own PC, NAS, or VPS with Docker Compose and PostgreSQL. Optional OCR turns supplier bills into reviewable stock entries. No monthly per-shop fee.

records.name: ToneDay
records.tagline: Home video workouts, starting with one free minute
records.description: Choose your level, workout focus, equipment and time. ToneDay builds 1–20 minute home routines with real exercise videos. Use a towel, water bottles, a chair—or no equipment. One-minute sessions are free with an ad; longer routines require paid access. Available on Android and the web, with English and Czech UI.

records.name: LyricLayer
records.tagline: Lyrics for YouTube songs without lyric captions
records.description: LyricLayer looks up lyrics from LRCLIB, NetEase and optional Kugou, even when a YouTube video has no lyric captions. Follow matching timed lyrics inside the player or in a floating window. Choose a recording, adjust the delay, repair line timing and loop a verse to practise. Free for Chrome and Edge, with no account or ads. Availability and timing vary by song and source.

records.name: MatchRadar
records.tagline: Your CV, matched to each weekday's new jobs, with reasons
records.description: Upload your CV once. Every weekday at 08:30 MatchRadar e-mails the new job postings that fit it, each with the requirements you meet, the partial ones and the gaps. Europe and the US, from employers' own career sites. Never auto-applies. 7 days free, no card.

records.name: WorkHoist
records.tagline: Construction management software with no per-user fees
records.description: WorkHoist is construction management software for general contractors and specialty trades. It runs the sales pipeline, estimates, projects, job costing, change orders, RFIs, submittals, punch lists and AIA G702/G703 billing in one system, at a flat monthly price with no per-user fees. It was built by a founder who ran construction crews for nearly 20 years, for contractors tired of paying per seat for modules nobody opens.

records.name: Scripture Alone
records.tagline: A free, open-source Bible with no ads, trackers or accounts
records.description: Scripture Alone is a free, open-source (AGPL-3.0) Bible for iPhone, iPad, Mac and Apple Watch. Read the ASV, BSB and KJV offline with full-text search and the words of Christ in red. Highlight, favorite and take notes on several passages at once, or snap a sermon slide to start one. Listen aloud, study with cross-references and classic commentary, and follow each chapter on an offline map and timeline. No ads, trackers or accounts; sync is your own iCloud.

records.name: NoteStrata
records.tagline: Interactive sticky notes right on your desktop wallpaper
records.description: NoteStrata transforms your Windows desktop into a cleaner, more productive workspace. Unlike traditional sticky notes that use floating windows, NoteStrata integrates notes and to-do lists directly into your desktop wallpaper. Key features: • Desktop Click-to-Check: toggle tasks directly on your wallpaper • Modern Color Studio, glass styling & 10 fonts • Lightweight & fast: minimal system resource usage • Free to use

records.name: Agent Island
records.tagline: Your MacBook notch as mission control for AI coding agents
records.description: Agent Island turns your MacBook notch into a live dashboard for Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Gemini CLI and OpenCode: every session, context, quota and cost. Approve permissions, answer questions and jump to the exact terminal tab. Free, MIT, fully local.

records.name: Claude Monitor
records.tagline: Never get cut off by a Claude usage limit again
records.description: Since the June launch: Free plan support (Claude stopped showing usage to Free accounts in August, so Claude Monitor reads the limits that every reply still carries), an optional bar right above claude.ai's chat box, and an interface in 8 languages. Plus the core: live 5-hour session and weekly limits, per-model caps, extra usage credits, a countdown to every reset, alerts at 80% and 95%, and 30 days of history. Open source, no account, nothing leaves your browser.

records.name: GRAINSIFT
records.tagline: Check factory cost sheets line by line, from both sides
records.description: Factory costing still runs on emailed Excel sheets. Lines don't add up, the reason behind each price is unclear, and every round restarts from "too expensive." GRAINSIFT puts brand and factory on the same sheet: any format, checked line by line, math first, then every negotiation round tracked until both sides land on one final number. Neutral by design: brand margins stay private, factories submit free. Team admins see approvals, activity and margin across the line.

records.name: SalaryNspect - ProSal Calculator
records.tagline: Know what you should be paid - Before payday
records.description: SalaryNspect is built for people whose pay isn't as simple as a salary. Model production or commission-based compensation, track the numbers that drive your earnings, and compare expected pay with what was actually reported. It supports guarantees, production rates, negative accrual, offer comparisons, and compensation trends—all without requiring an account or uploading your financial data to an outside service.

records.name: JobFoundry | Your AI Powered Job Assist
records.tagline: Local-first AI job search, fit scoring & truthful resumes
records.description: Job hunting is broken with pricey subscriptions and LLMs that hallucinate skills. JobFoundry is an AGPL-3.0, 100% local-first pipeline: - Ingestion: Captures 87 job boards/ATS via your browser session (no server scraping) - Dedup: 64-bit SimHash collapses cross-posted duplicates - Fit Scoring: 0-100 match grades using local Ollama or OpenAI APIs - Resumes: Schema-enforced, truthful ATS PDF tailoring - Dashboard: Local Kanban tracking

records.name: Bookletto for Family
records.tagline: Clone your voice for your child's storytime
records.description: Busy day, away from home, but one more story? Bookletto lets parents clone their voice from a few short recordings, so children can hear English stories in a voice they know. Create new adventures with on-device AI or write your own, then play them in your saved parent voice on iPhone or iPad. Voice cloning and narration run on-device; recordings aren't uploaded for speech generation. Five free listening minutes daily, with optional Family Reading plans for unlimited narration.

records.name: Codex Window Colors
records.tagline: Tell your Codex windows apart with colors
records.description: Give each Codex Desktop window a color that follows its chat or project. Pick your own colors or use stable automatic ones, then adjust the edge thickness, fade, and opacity. A local macOS utility that runs through Hammerspoon. Requires Hammerspoon, Python 3, and Accessibility permission.

records.name: ToonFlip
records.tagline: Flip cartoons into real-world discoveries for kids
records.description: ToonFlip is a free, offline learning game for iPhone and iPad. Tap illustrated cards to reveal real photos and hear spoken names, with real-world sounds for animals, vehicles, objects and instruments. Explore 174 cards across 8 categories, with English, Hungarian and German voices and 50 interface languages. No ads, accounts or in-app purchases—just playful discovery for young children and their families.

records.name: Melaya MCP Server
records.tagline: Give the assistant you already use tools, a phone, a browser
records.description: One remote MCP endpoint turns Claude, ChatGPT or Cursor into an agent that acts. Your AI drives a real Android phone and your own browser, then designs, tests and runs multi-agent pipelines on 8,000+ scoped tools. Laya, our free System One model, is built in for instant decisions at scale. Bring any of 49+ AI providers, cloud or local, with no lock-in. Every consequential action waits for your approval, access is scoped per tool and site, and every run is traced and replayable.

records.name: Trove
records.tagline: Good ideas deserve a new owner.
