records.description: A free, India-first WordPress block theme for NGOs. Editable patterns for donations, transparency documents, programs, impact stories, volunteers and trustees. Five colour styles. No paid plugin needed for the theme. Available on WordPress.org.

records.name: TasksMate
records.tagline: Plan tasks, track time and send invoices — in one app
records.description: TasksMate is one happy home for freelance work. Plan tasks and projects, run a focus timer, log your hours, and turn them into a clean invoice — all from your phone. ✨ AI Magic Build turns a goal into a full project plan 🎙 Meeting Assistant records a meeting and writes the summary + action items 🧠 Project Brain answers "what's overdue?" in plain words Plus habits, docs, team chat, contracts with e-signature and expense scanning. Free to start.

records.name: Jin
records.tagline: Simple, Stable and Fast AI Harness
records.description: Stable, Simple and Fast AI Agent, Use it with any API - ethanhamilthon/jin Jin is a simple, even slightly boring AI coding agent. It comes with the tools you need to get started, without a config file to maintain. If you are tired of AI hype and rebuilding your workflow every week, Jin is for you. We deliberately left things out to build a straightforward agent that gets your work done. Jin is built to be fast and token-efficient.

records.name: Toonify
records.tagline: Create a custom animated mascot for your brand
records.description: Toonify turns a one-line description into an animated mascot for your app or website. Pick a base, describe your character, choose its moves (wave, jump, dance, blink and more), and download one lightweight Rive or Lottie file. Play any move with a single line of code on iOS, Android, Flutter, React Native and the web. No designers, no animators, no heavy GIFs or videos. Start free, then pay as you go from $5

records.name: Impedo: Insistent App Blocker
records.tagline: The blocker that pushes back
records.description: Blocking an app is easy. The hard part is not unblocking it five minutes later. Impedo was built for that second part. Pick the apps, pick a duration, tap IMPEDIR. They stop opening. When the urge to quit early hits, the Insistent Shield steps in and rolls a task: wait it out, solve a sum in your head, shake your iPhone, walk a few steps, or clear a memory game. You can still quit — just not on impulse. No VPN, no third-party profile, no data leaving your iPhone.

records.name: FillxForm
records.tagline: Apply to jobs faster with free AI-powered form autofill.
records.description: FillXFrom is a free AI-powered job application autofill extension that saves time on repetitive forms. Export your profile as JSON, use AI with your resume to fill missing details, and import the completed JSON back into the extension. Autofill supported job application forms in seconds. Built for students, freshers, and job seekers. Less typing, more applying!

records.name: Pointr
records.tagline: AI that understands and interacts with your desktop
records.description: Pointr is a Windows overlay that sees what's on your screen, answers in place, and can act on your behalf, with your permission, every time. Use Storyboard to visually explain and annotate anything on screen, or Agent Mode to perform multi-step desktop tasks. It also supports browser automation, MCP tools, push-to-talk voice, and Gemini/OpenAI models. Open source. No login or signup required. Privacy-first, with telemetry off by default.

records.name: Fangmanle
records.tagline: Self-hosted AI-native hotel PMS for boutique hotels
records.description: Boutique hotels don’t need another multi-property cloud PMS. They need one property’s rooms, rates, night audit, and guest chat to stop living in separate tools. Fangmanle is a self-hosted hotel PMS for independents: front desk, rooms, finance, and guests in one place. AI helps where it matters—ask about your numbers, explain a rate, draft a shift handover—and you can turn it off without breaking daily ops. Try the live demo (sample hotel data). Open source if you want to run it yourself.

records.name: Weekend Giveaway: Win a $50 Gift Card
records.tagline: Weekend Giveaway: Win a $50 Gift Card
records.description: Entries close Sunday. Follow, submit your details, and see if you’re our random winner.

records.name: Shadowban Radar
records.tagline: Is X shadowbanning you? Free check in seconds, no login
records.description: Your views on X dropped and nobody told you why? 👀 Shadowban Radar runs a free Twitter (X) shadowban test on any public account, with no login or password: 4 checks (search suggestion ban, search ban, ghost ban, reply deboosting), a verdict, and a confidence level for each check. Want to stop checking by hand? A one-time pass re-checks your account through the day and emails you when a restriction starts or lifts. No subscription.

records.name: Greek Flashcards Pro
records.tagline: Learn Modern Greek with high-frequency words
records.description: Greek Flashcards Pro is a free browser app to learn Modern Greek using the most frequently used words, sentences, verbs. • 800+ flashcards (vocabulary, sentences, conjugations) • Multilanguage EN or NL • Full grammar theory + 50 frequent verbs with complete tables • Pronunciation (text-to-speech), mark “I know this”, swipe & list view • Interface in English and Dutch — no install, works on phone and desktop Built for beginners and travelers who want practical Greek fast.

records.name: Mewvori
records.tagline: A digital pet that grows with your real-life habits
records.description: Meet Mewvori, a digital pet companion that grows alongside your real-life habits. Your pet has its own daily rhythm, little discoveries, and memories to share. As you build healthy habits and care for your companion, your stories grow together. Coming soon to iOS and Android! 🐼🌱

records.name: base31.org
records.tagline: Find launches, get discovered
records.description: Explore base31.org, an independent directory of cool sites, fun websites, creative web projects, and useful online tools built for the open web.

records.name: Reference Checker
records.tagline: Verify your bibliography and catch wrong citations
records.description: Check an entire bibliography against scholarly records. Paste references or import PDF, Word, BibTeX, RIS, and more. Catch wrong DOIs, compare titles and authors, review uncertain matches, and apply source-backed corrections in 7 citation styles. Export reports or share results. Free daily checks: 100 for guests and 500 when signed in.

records.name: MascoAI
records.tagline: Design Tools, Artificial Intelligence, Developer Tools
records.description: Create a brand mascot from text, a photo or a logo. Animate it with a one-line prompt, export transparent WebM, GIF or APNG, or embed an interactive version that follows the cursor and reacts to clicks.

records.name: AVENALO
records.tagline: Tu bienestar en un solo lugar
records.description: Recetas, movimiento, hidratación, ayuno y buenos hábitos. Gratis, sin registro y con tus datos personales guardados únicamente en tu dispositivo.

records.name: When To Replace The Safety Harness
records.tagline: 5 Signs It’s Time to Replace Your Safety Harness
records.description: Many workers wonder when to replace the safety harness to ensure their safety when working at heights. In this article, Thien Bang explains the warning signs

records.name: MagicBox
records.tagline: Turn 4 images into high-converting 3D video ads in 60s.
records.description: Transform product images into scroll-stopping 3D rotating video ads in under 60 seconds — without After Effects, Blender, or 3D designers. • 100% in-browser WebGL rendering (instant MP4 export) • Multiple aspect ratios (1:1 Feed, 9:16 Stories/TikTok, 16:9) • Custom background colors, speed, and audio with fade-out 🎁 Product Hunt Special: Exclusive Lifetime Deal ($79 one-time) for the first 100 builders. 30 renders/mo forever!

records.name: Nody
records.tagline: Node-based canvas chat to compare GPT, Claude & Gemini
records.description: Nody is a node-based canvas chat for comparing the best AI models side by side. Ask once, see GPT, Claude and Gemini answer on the same canvas, then branch from any answer. One shared credit pool for every model. Credits never expire.

records.name: ioreum
records.tagline: K-Saju birth-chart readings — computed, not vibes
records.description: ioreum turns your birth date, time and place into a Korean Saju (Four Pillars) chart with real calendar math: solar terms to the minute, true solar time for where you were born. Then an AI writes your reading from that chart, and it can't change a single number. Free: a full chart calculator, all 60 day pillars, a Korean name matched to your chart. Readings are one-time credits from $4.99, no subscription.

records.name: Easy Screen Capture
records.tagline: Capture websites, track changes, and share client reports
records.description: Capture full-page websites, compare changes, and share visual reports with clients. Schedule monitors with adjustable alerts, organize captures into projects, and work from your browser or installable PWA. Start free with 20 screenshots per month.

records.name: Herbie: Cat Games & Care
records.tagline: Games for your cat. Shared care for their humans.
records.description: Three games made for cats: Mouse Hunt, Bird Watching with real birdsong, and Goldfish Pond. Keep meals, water, litter and key dates together, share care through iCloud, and bring your cat to your Home Screen as PixelHerb. Free games and care for your first cat on iPhone and iPad. No ads or subscription. Optional one-time Herbie Pro adds more cats and Apple Watch.

records.name: typed.cc
records.tagline: Show how much of your email you actually typed
records.description: typed.cc is a chrome extension that tracks how much of an email you actually typed, and adds a signed badge. no data leaves your browser except the final score.

records.name: Landscape Plan
records.tagline: Plan outdoor spaces with AI from a photo
records.description: Landscape Plan helps you explore landscape design ideas using photos of your real outdoor space. Upload a yard, garden, patio, or other outdoor area, choose a space type and style, and generate different design directions with AI. You can describe what should stay, change, or be added, then compare the result with the original photo before moving on to real planning or renovation.

records.name: Hiragana Chart
records.tagline: All 46 hiragana characters, with stroke order and audio
records.description: A free chart of all 46 hiragana characters, with stroke order and audio.

records.name: The Crypto Board
records.tagline: Claim the #1 spot for your crypto project
records.description: The Crypto Board has 19 boards for chains and sectors, each with one #1 spot. Listing is free. An empty #1 costs $10, and the price rises each time someone takes it over. Every holder is recorded on the history page forever.

records.name: Folio & Kit  October Creator Pro Edition
records.tagline: The AI brand-deal assistant for creators
records.description: Your AI business advisor, built into every deal. Folio and Kit helps creators manage brand deals professionally. Rate cards, media kits, contracts, invoices, and deal tracking — all in one place. Know what to charge with a rate calculator built on real market and platform data. Track every deal from first outreach to paid invoice. Send contracts with built-in e-signature. Get paid faster with automated invoice reminders

records.name: Workbook
records.tagline: Keep your project work connected.
records.description: Keep your project work connected — from timelines and tasks to documentation, constraints, and visual workflows.

records.name: ScanQR - QR Code & Barcode
records.tagline: QR, Scan, QR Code, Bar Code, ScanQR, ScanQR & Barcode
records.description: ScanQR doesn't just read codes, it understands them. Payment QRs from 9 systems (VietQR, Pix, UPI, PromptPay, SEPA and more) show the bank, account and amount. Product barcodes pull details from Open Food Facts. Every link is checked for phishing, look-alike domains and hidden short links before you open it. Create codes with your own colors and logo, and the app tests that they still scan. Also: scan from photos, searchable history, 23 languages.

records.name: RunRoutes
records.tagline: Pick a distance, get a running loop from your front door
records.description: Pick a distance, tap once, and RunRoutes draws a running loop that starts and ends at your own front door. No planning, no retracing your steps. Run it from your wrist: Apple Watch taps you before every turn and speaks the directions, while your iPhone shows the run on a full-screen map. Add run/walk intervals, follow the built-in Couch to 5K plan, or send any route as GPX to the app you already use. Two free routes every week, no card needed.

records.name: Mixee AI
records.tagline: 1100+ AI Models. Multi-LLM Arena & Unified AI Engine.
records.description: Mixee AI gives you direct access to 1100+ AI models under single dashboard for a fraction of the cost. Compare, benchmark, and chat with Google Gemini, OpenAI GPT-4o, Claude 3.7, DeepSeek R1 and 1100+ AI models (including Agentic AI agents) at MixeeAI.com. Pricing starts from $2 only. No need to have expensive multiple subscriptions for every other AI tool. We also have a pool of completely FREE AI Models.

records.name: Uxel
records.tagline: Elevate the Chances Into Your Dream College
records.description: Your AI-powered admissions companion at every step—matching colleges, writing essays, and tracking your applications. Essay Agent: Get feedback that reads like an admissions officer, with a grade, strengths, weaknesses, and a clear recommendation on what to fix next. College Guide Agent: Meet Ed. Your college guide to thriving. Talk to Ed — just like you would a college counselor. College Explorer: Stop guessing your fit. Start matching with real numbers. No more spreadsheets or speculation.

records.name: Suggest Me a Movie
records.tagline: Four movie picks for your mood, language and time
records.description: Find your next watch with four suggestions at a time. Describe your mood, preferred language and runtime to Sara AI, try 1-Click Roulette, or like and pass films in the Swipe Deck. Explore Indian and world cinema, save a wishlist, and keep watched films out of future recommendations. Google sign-in is required for interactive features and saved collections.
